title: Skill delete guard: dated incidents
desc: T3 dated archive for harness-skill-delete-guard: the measured refusals, the head-match hazard, the truncated echo, and the E16-versus-score-gate contradiction. Core: harness-skill-delete-guard. Procedures: harness-skill-delete-guard-howto.
steps: INCIDENT: E16 and the score gate contradict each other in writing, so the cheapest lossless remedy is unusable. WHEN: a score gate tells you to merge steps sharing a HOW and delete the absorbed one, and E16 then refuses that delete. HOW: run wkappbot skill read harness-skill-delete-guard-howto for the archive-first procedure, then expect this refusal and do not retry -- until E16 searches the skill ITSELF as well as its siblings, merge-then-delete cannot complete. WHY: measured 2026-09-05 on claude-session-handoff. The skill-currency block states verbatim that nothing leaves the skill so no sibling-verification pass is needed; E16 refused anyway, because it searches only howto, ref, ref-t3, ref-t4-archive and ref-t5-archive and never the skill's own remaining steps. The cost is not the refusal but where it pushes you: migration to a sibling becomes the only route, and that RELOCATES the lock rather than clearing it, since the archive absorbs step count and pays in score point for point.

requirements.expect: E16 and the score gate contradict
